name: Zenithal-Bastion
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past an ancient meteor crater, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, silicon, titanium and rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
